## Download

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `Prism-<Product>-Setup-<version>-x64.exe` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon (M1–M4) | `Prism-<Product>-<version>-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Prism-<Product>-<version>-mac-x64.dmg` (not smoke-tested in CI) |
| Linux (x64) | `Prism-<Product>-<version>-linux-x86_64.AppImage` or `.deb` |

The builds are not signed with a paid certificate, so the first launch needs one extra click: Windows SmartScreen → **More info → Run anyway**; macOS → **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Details: [README](https://github.com/ugurshelby/prism#install).
